description: This file implements Vulkan secondary command buffer management, including creation, cleanup, swapchain-dependent resource setup, and frame recording within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It defines methods for initializing Vulkan pipeline objects, creating framebuffers, command pools, and command buffers, and recording rendering commands.

classes.name: SecondaryCommandBuffer
classes.description: A class managing Vulkan secondary command buffers, including setup, cleanup, swapchain resource management, and frame recording.

methods.name: BuildVulkanSampleApp
methods.description: Builds and returns a Vulkan sample application by creating a SecondaryCommandBuffer instance.

methods.name: SecondaryCommandBuffer::Create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate and initialize a SecondaryCommandBuffer object.

methods.name: SecondaryCommandBuffer::StartUp
methods.description: Initializes Vulkan pipeline objects, shader modules, and other resources needed for rendering.

methods.name: SecondaryCommandBuffer::CleanUp
methods.description: Cleans up Vulkan resources and waits for device idle before shutdown.

methods.name: SecondaryCommandBuffer::CreateSwapchainDependents
methods.description: Creates framebuffers, command pools, and command buffers for each swapchain image, setting up the rendering pipeline.

methods.name: SecondaryCommandBuffer::DestroySwapchainDependents
methods.description: Destroys or resets swapchain-dependent resources such as framebuffers, command pools, and command buffers.

methods.name: SecondaryCommandBuffer::RecordFrame
methods.description: Records rendering commands into the command buffer for a specific frame.
